split.release_rule: gate fixed on the first 7 distinct trade days, stored and committed before the first outcome print; read per the signed spec only

costs.note: fees ASSUMED, per side, of notional; haircuts per fill, relative

tries.prior_m: the carried m of the day plus 16, printed first

closest_existing: PERP1 to PERP3 (daily trend on perps, FALSIFIED)
declined_list_rows_checked: lead-lag between related markets (the basis is a perp against its own reference price, not another market's move)
uniqueness.difference: funding extremes and the perp-versus-reference basis on the six crypto perps; 7g: follow and fade cells inside each family are versions and counted as tries

extracts: perp-data perps/ hourly snapshots (six crypto perps, from 2026-10-21), the 60 second recorder (PR 998), the PERPBTC1M 1 minute candles (BTC only, 2026-06-03 to 2026-11-12), a labelled funding pull (not yet existing)

window.first_close: pending Auditor B and the first labelled-funding day

data.independence_note: no other card reads the crypto perps; the BTC perp 1 minute pull is read only by registered readers (the held-out log)

event.decision_instant: FUNDX: the first price after a funding print; BASIS: each snapshot
event.entry_rule: FUNDX 8 cells (trigger decile or clamp, fade or follow, hold 8 h or 24 h) and BASIS 8 cells (threshold 5 or 10 bps, converge or follow, hold 1 h or 4 h)

prediction: at least one cell has PF >= 1.3 at taker with the 0.02 percent haircut and PF >= 1.0 at the 0.05 percent haircut, n >= 100, a pooled rate >= 3 a day and a BH pass; prior low
kill: a cell is dropped when its pooled rate over the first 7 trade days is under 3.0 a day or its first read has PF under 1.0 at the primary haircut (kill_fast)

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF at taker 0.02 and 0.05 percent, n, days, rate a day, margin return and liquidation share at 10, 25 and 50 percent of the maximum leverage

needs_new_code: labelled funding pull or a recorder class change (Main)
owner's word on a spot source for basis history (or forward only)

holds.label: crypto perps (the six tickers)
holds.card: none known; PERPMON1 holds stock perps only; Auditor B to confirm

names: Kalshi public perps list, funding history and candles (recorders and pulls)

subset_rationale: a single rule registered before any forward row existed; no figure from the forward window was seen
halves: by entry time: the first floor(n/2) trades and the rest
fee_form: ceil(round(100 x 0.07 x c x p x (1 - p), 9)) / 100 per order at c = 10; a void refunds the price and keeps the fee

look_ahead.decision_instant: the funding print's time (FUNDX) or the snapshot's time (BASIS)
look_ahead.inputs: FUNDX: the market's own earlier funding prints only (expanding decile, at least 60 prints) and the print itself; BASIS: the snapshot's own price and reference_price
look_ahead.entry_quote: the first price after the decision (FUNDX) or the snapshot's far touch (BASIS)
look_ahead.exit_price: the price at the hold's end; funding booked from the prints inside the hold
